fact: Running /taskbook-setup attaches Pi model, repository, and tool diagnostics to the current conversation.
Setup requires explicit approval to archive .audit and separate approval to delete the archived original.
Setup saves the model table path and Git tracking policy as separate keys in .fact/taskbook.tsv. A T3 worktree reads the settings from its taskbook baseline.
Setup uses the existing Git ignore rules or the common Git info/exclude to keep a local project model table outside Git tracking.
Pi connects codemode MCP servers in the background. Setup gives configured Magpie a bounded registration window and reports T3 Issue and PR tools independently of the Magpie GitHub delivery contract.
